notes.notes:
fix bug that made level 17.7 unsolvable

notes.title: Update 1.1.5
notes.notes:
Hello Rebuilders!

Update 1.1.5 is ready, adding 2 new chapters with 19 new islands for you to solve, in addition to a few bugfixes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34950040/293629f920763e8c9b004afe715372d5368786f7.png

Changes

 2 new chapters: "Opportunity in Disguise" and "Opportunity in Disguise +"
 19 new medium to difficult levels


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34950040/9c24ed9085f81c7b6e51eaf23fc1bc5f70c5aa9a.png

Bugfixes

 The 2 achievements from "Opportunity in Disguise" are finally obtainable (sorry for adding them too early ;) )
 Achievements are synced at game startup now. So if you had any issues with achievements not registering, that should help
 Several small UI improvements


As always, if you have questions, feedback, or want to hang out, you are always welcome to join the Puzzle Pelago Discord server :)

Happy rebuilding,
- Christopher

notes.title: Hotfix for 1.1.1: Apple Silicon support
notes.notes: Fixed an issue that caused the game to crash on startup on M1 Macs.

notes.title: 1.1.1 Update
notes.notes:
Hello, Rebuilders!

Update 1.1.1 for Puzzle Pelago is out now, bringing lots of new feaures!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34950040/8aa18ac677137c05acb649310d42954370d61c17.gif

Changes

 Undo/Redo buttons
 Inspect mode for when you want to have a look at your solutions
 The levels in most chapters can be played in any order now
 4 languages supported now (English, French, German and Spanish)
 Redesigned chapter buttons
 Lots of performance optimizations and bug fixes
 For mac users: Native Apple Silicon support (and continued Intel mac support, of course), and support for macOS Big Sur (the .app is notarized!)


Testing for version 1.1.5 with two new chapters is already under way, so stay tuned for those!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34950040/c63809edaaf36b8d0762db69fec68e032e09ed10.gif

Thanks to every one of you for the continued support, it means a lot!

If you like the game and want to help spread the word, you can always leave a steam review - it really helps small indie studios like me a lot!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34950040/7c2d693725b680aa87423af60fc77f3264342486.gif

Thats it for now! 

If you have any questions, feedback or want to contact me for any other reason, you can join the Discord (https://discord.gg/puzzlepelago) or DM me on Twitter @hallgrimgames.

Happy rebuilding!
- Christopher

notes.title: 1.0.1 Update
notes.notes:
Are you ready?
Puzzle Pelago is out now! Wooo! :)

This has truly been a journey. And on the way to the finish line I found another few smaller issues to fix, before the big day today!

Changes  (1.0.1):

 Improve scroll speed in menus on windows
 Fix error where cursor could be locked to a small rectangle when “lock cursor” and “windowed’ were activated at the same time
 The game no longer responds to keypresses in the background while typing a crash dialogue explanation
 The HG logo on the title screen now sends you to hallgrimgames.com, as it should


Thanks again to everyone who reported issues, you are my heroes!

Have fun + Stay Safe!
- Christopher

notes.title: 1.0 (Release) Update
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone ...
... who helped testing Puzzle Pelago! Your feedback has pointed my attention to a number of issues I was able to iron out before release, that I would not have found without you!

This week, Puzzle Pelago will release, on April 30th :D This is my first Steam launch, and my nerves are killing me. But I think all the work of the past months has paid off :)

Trailer
Also, I had a lot of fun creating a release trailer last week, hope you enjoy:
[previewyoutube=INPDr7Wa-WY;full][/previewyoutube]


Here are the fruits of your feedback (and my work :D)

Changes  (1.0.0):

 1.0 release, hooray!
 Fix some missing localizations
 Fix crashes related to quickly mashing ESC in some menus
 Fix visual glitch of combined-workshop-paths after loading from save state
 Fix UI scale not always applying correctly in all menus
 Add optional explanation text field for the crash dialogue (hope no-one will see it, though!)
 Return to Chapter Select menu after completing a chapter, even if the game was started via "Continue" button
 Tutorial dialogue improvements
 Fix consistent application of title case in some headings
 Fix level transition animation sometimes stopping when alt-tabbing mid-way through the animation
 balance ambient sound effect levels
 optimize building click targets
 Clean up recipe / "how to make" UI
 *all* inaccessible resources/buildings should now be non-interactable. in some cases they still were.



Have fun + Stay Safe!
- Christopher

notes.title: Closed Beta Bugfix Update
notes.notes:
Closed beta testing is under way and going well! 

Thanks to everyone who is playing Puzzle Pelago before release - your feedback is extremely valuable to me and will help me make Puzzle Pelago be in its best shape upon release!

If you want to participate in beta testing - please email me at   beta _at_ puzzlepelago.com  !

Changes  (0.9.9-33):

 A number of crashes have been fixed
 The "Brewing Beer" chapter unlock conditions now require the "Making Barrels" chapter be completed


Have fun + Stay Safe!
- Christopher
